title: Minkov's double-double earns Final Four MVP as Vidabasket complete historic Bulgarian BBL double
description: Vidabasket capped a season for the ages on Sunday, demolishing Haskovo 97-78 in the BBL National Finals title game to complete the domestic double adding the national championship to the BBL Cup they won earlier in the campaign. The Vidin-based club were utterly dominant in the biggest game of their season, never giving Haskovo a sniff as they pulled away for a comfortable 19-point victory. Final Four MVP Damyan Minkov (197-F-2002) was the driving force once again with a double-double of 24 points and 11 rebounds, continuing the form that carried Vidabasket through the entire campaign.
